HIGH.reason: Selected scenes add concrete role/environment context to listening tasks and improve situational comprehension.

MEDIUM.reason: Most scenes add workplace realism; generic office-background cases should not be prioritized ahead of role-rich contexts.

LOW.reason: Low items remain valid supplemental context but should be deferred unless reuse or UX evidence justifies generation.

ruleChange: Generic single-scene office/environment records without distinct participant roles or memorable situational cues move down one priority band; role-rich, reusable workplace contexts remain HIGH.
